In this case, friction reduces the tension force not by some fixed amount or by some factor. If the string slides over the surface, the relationship between the tension forces on the two sides of the string is given by Euler's formula {0} where {1} is the coefficient of friction between the string and the surface, and {2} is the wrap angle (in radians). Note that the radius of the cylindrical surface does not appear in this formula.
